description: Sets the verification status of a submitted evidence record to verified or rejected. The caller must present an EIP-712 authority proof and hold an unrevoked, unexpired EVALUATOR authorization on the commitment (verified in-transaction). Idempotent per verdict: re-verifying with the same verdict replays the original outcome; changing a verified record to rejected (or vice versa) is rejected without a dispute path. Does NOT auto-transition the commitment state � the caller must perform the authorized lifecycle transition separately. Rejection requires a reason.

evidenceId.description: The evidence record ID to verify

name: verify_evidence
title: Verify or reject submitted evidence
